supporting_observations.claim: The supplied svc-inventory failures begin at 13:35:58 and recur at roughly one-minute intervals through 13:50:53, consistent with the stated once-per-minute InventorySync job.

The failures consistently identify FILE-BLU-01 as the workstation and 10.54.20.20 as the source; the FILE-BLU-01 events also report the same LSASS process ID. This is consistent with the expected job host, not evidence of an unfamiliar source.

The FILE-BLU-01 events report bad-password substatus 0xc000006a, and corresponding domain-controller authentication records report the same status or Kerberos pre-authentication failure. The supplied records show failed authentication, not a successful logon.
The timing and repeated stale-password failures are consistent with the stated 13:30 svc-inventory password rotation while the InventorySync job still needed a manual credential update.

known_telemetry_limitations: The supplied authentication records end at 13:50:53, so they do not cover the full requested window through 14:20 UTC.
The records show the reported process as LSASS, but do not independently establish which application or service initiated each authentication attempt.
The supplied evidence does not include the password-rotation execution or InventorySync job-update logs.
claims_not_established: Whether the service credential was updated after the failures shown.
Whether any successful svc-inventory authentication occurred after 13:50:53 or elsewhere in the requested window.
Whether the scheduled rotation was completed exactly as planned.
